form.title: SCRATCH-TCRmerge: join TCR tables onto a GEX object
form.description: Adds per-cell TCR data (TCRtoolkit's bridge/merged_vdj_object/post_qc_cells.tsv) to an annotated GEX AnnData as .obs columns, matched by cell barcode. The expression matrix is never loaded, so runtime does not scale with cell count. Select both the TCRtoolkit output dataset and the GEX dataset under 'Datasets to use'. Outputs merged.h5ad plus the joined tables as .tsv and .rds.

gex_h5ad_selected.title: GEX object (.h5ad)
gex_h5ad_selected.description: Pick the GEX AnnData to annotate, e.g. SCRATCH-QC's data/SCRATCH_QC:EXPORT_H5AD_SINGLET/data/*_singlet.h5ad. Point this at the SCRATCH-Annotation object instead if you need cell-type labels. Leave empty to auto-discover using the filename pattern below.

tcr_table_selected.title: TCR per-cell table (.tsv)
tcr_table_selected.description: Pick the per-cell TCR table to join, normally TCRtoolkit's data/bridge/merged_vdj_object/post_qc_cells.tsv. Leave empty to auto-discover using the filename pattern below.

gex_h5ad_pattern.title: GEX object filename
gex_h5ad_pattern.description: Glob pattern selecting the GEX .h5ad from the chosen datasets. SCRATCH-QC names its object per run (e.g. GBM_DFCI1_CSF_singlet.h5ad), so the default matches any *_singlet.h5ad. Note cell-type labels come from SCRATCH-Annotation, not SCRATCH-QC.

tcr_table_pattern.title: TCR table filename
tcr_table_pattern.description: Which per-cell TCR table to take from the TCRtoolkit dataset. Falls back to any *_cells.tsv (preferring post_qc) if this name is not found.

tcr_passthrough_patterns.title: Other TCR files to carry over
tcr_passthrough_patterns.description: Comma-separated filenames from the same TCRtoolkit folder, copied into the merged dataset under tcr_source/ without being joined (the summaries are per-sample, the .rds files are R objects, and pre_qc_cells.tsv repeats the same barcodes). Plain names are looked up next to the TCR table you picked, so they work even though Cirro's file listing shows only part of a dataset; wildcards like *_summary.tsv are matched against that listing instead. Missing files are skipped with a warning. Leave empty to carry nothing over.

sample_col.title: Sample column
sample_col.description: Column in the TCR table holding the sample name. Used to build sample-prefixed barcode candidates.

barcode_col.title: Barcode column
barcode_col.description: Column in the TCR table holding the cell barcode.

cell_id_col.title: Cell ID column
cell_id_col.description: Column holding a composite cell id (e.g. <sample>_<barcode>). Synthesised from sample + barcode if absent.

library_tokens.title: Library-type words to ignore in sample names
library_tokens.description: Comma-separated words removed from sample names before matching, so paired libraries line up: BTC-GBM-001-001-GEX and BTC-GBM-001-001-TCR both become BTC-GBM-001-001. Matched as whole tokens, so they can sit anywhere in the name (e.g. ...-S3-GEX-LIB). Clear it to require identical sample names.

obs_prefix.title: Prefix for added columns
obs_prefix.description: Prepended to every TCR column added to .obs, so nothing in the GEX object is overwritten.

min_match_rate.title: Minimum barcode match rate
min_match_rate.description: Abort if the best barcode convention matches fewer than this fraction of TCR rows. Guards against a silently wrong join.

subset_to_tcr.title: Also write a TCR-only object
subset_to_tcr.description: Additionally write merged.tcr_only.h5ad containing just the cells that carry TCR data. This one does read the matrix for the kept cells.

emit_rds.title: Also write .rds tables
emit_rds.description: Write .rds copies of the output tables so they can be opened directly in R.
